title: Good sealer
text: Good sealer. I was surprised at how powerful this little gadget is. It comes with 3 small bags and 3 larger bags, usb cord for charging, a wrist strap that I didnt really use. There are a few drawbacks though. The cord is less than a foot long so it needs to plugged in very close to the outlet...so keep that in mind. Also when charging the unit, there is only the red light on and nothing changes to indicate when it is fully charged. I charged it for over an hour right out of the box and it worked great on sealing a small bag, that I tried for this review. I like that when it is finished pulling the air out, it shuts itself off. This is a very useful tool. The bags can be washed and reused. They are nice, thick and sturdy.
